dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed type of admissible runs for natural dimensions b and r. Through its constructor D020, a run packages the input matrices, factor matrices, real parameters, approximation errors and bounds, orthonormality assumptions, unit-roundoff assumptions, and a certified three-stage multiplication trace.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem quantifies over inhabitants of this type, so all packaged conditions act as implicit hypotheses. It does not assert that such a run exists.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The first field of a run, namely the matrix A in R^(b x b).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A is the reference left matrix in the second error bound and in the exact product AB.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The second field of a run, namely the matrix B in R^(b x b).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: B is the reference right matrix in the second error bound and in the exact product AB.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The third field of a run, namely XA in R^(b x r).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms Atilde = XA YA^T, indexes the computation trace, and is required by the run to have orthonormal columns.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fifth field of a run, namely XB in R^(b x r).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms Btilde = YB XB^T, indexes the computation trace, and is required by the run to have orthonormal columns.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fourth field of a run, namely YA in R^(b x r).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms Atilde = XA YA^T and participates in the first multiplication stage YA^T YB.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The sixth field of a run, namely YB in R^(b x r).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms Btilde = YB XB^T and participates in the first multiplication stage YA^T YB.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: The eighth field of a run, the real parameter betaA.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the assumption ||EA||_F <= epsilon betaA and in the perturbation term of the second conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ninth field of a run, the real parameter betaB.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the assumption ||EB||_F <= epsilon betaB and in the perturbation term of the second conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The seventh field of a run, the real parameter epsilon.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It scales both factor-approximation error bounds and the entire additional perturbation term in the second conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The twenty-first field of a run, a certified computation trace at unit roundoff u for XA, YA, XB, and YB.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its final-stage result is the computed matrix whose forward errors are bounded.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: The tenth field of a run, the real unit-roundoff parameter u.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines gammaC and every per-stage gamma factor, and the run requires 0 <= u and (b + 2r sqrt(r))u < 1.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: A function that case-splits on either trace association and returns the result matrix of its final multiplication stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the matrix denoted by the computed result in both norm inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: For n, the type of n-by-n real matrices, represented as functions Fin n -> Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of A, B, Atilde, Btilde, the approximation errors, the computed result, and all matrix differences in the conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius norm of a square real matrix, inherited from D027.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every matrix magnitude and error in the two conclusions is measured in the Frobenius norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: For real k and u, gamma(k,u) = ku/(1-ku).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines gammaC = gamma(b + 2r sqrt(r),u) and the analogous inner-dimension factors in multiplication-stage certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: For natural b and r, the real number kappa = b + 2r sqrt(r), with b and r cast to real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the operation-count-like coefficient in gammaC and in the run assumption kappa u < 1.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: For X,Y in R^(b x r), the b-by-b matrix XY^T.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines Atilde = XA YA^T and Btilde = YB XB^T.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication of two n-by-n real matrices: (AB)_(ij) = sum_k A_(ik)B_(kj).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms Atilde Btilde in the first error and AB in the second error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for an admissible run. It takes A,B in R^(b x b); XA,YA,XB,YB in R^(b x r); epsilon,betaA,betaB,u in R; proofs 0 <= u and (b+2r sqrt(r))u < 1; proofs that XA and XB have orthonormal columns; errors EA,EB in R^(b x b); identities XA YA^T = A+EA and YB XB^T = B+EB; bounds ||EA||_F <= epsilon betaA and ||EB||_F <= epsilon betaB; and a certified trace.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These constructor arguments are precisely the implicit data and hypotheses available for every quantified run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: A computation-trace type indexed by u and four b-by-r factors. Its constructors encode either of two parenthesizations of three certified approximate matrix multiplications.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts the computed result to arise from either the left-associated or right-associated multiplication route described by D031 and D032.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: A case-elimination wrapper for a trace, accepting one branch for each of its two association constructors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It lets D013 extract the same final-stage result regardless of which association the trace uses.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: For m and n, the type of m-by-n real matrices, represented as functions Fin m -> Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes all rectangular dimensions of the factors and intermediate multiplication stages.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certified approximate multiplication stage for A in R^(m x n) and B in R^(n x p) at parameter u. Via D034 it contains an m-by-p additive error satisfying a Frobenius-norm bound.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every multiplication in the trace must obey the local model result = AB + error with ||error||_F <= gamma(n,u)||A||_F||B||_F.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: The result of a certified stage, defined as the exact matrix product AB plus the stage's stored error matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Intermediate and final trace results are additive-error perturbations of their corresponding exact products.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: A type-level proof that 1+1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports interpretation of the numeral 2 used in real arithmetic; it contributes no substantive hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a real m-by-n matrix A, sqrt(sum_i sum_j A_(ij)^2), the Frobenius norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the exact norm used by D015, stage-error bounds, and factor-approximation bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary rectangular matrix multiplication: for A in R^(m x n) and B in R^(n x p), (AB)_(ij) = sum_k A_(ik)B_(kj).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines factor products and every exact product underlying a certified multiplication stage.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix transpose: (A^T)_(ji) = A_(ij).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies YA^T and XB^T in Atilde, Btilde, and the computation trace.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: Another case-elimination wrapper for the two trace constructors, implemented using the trace recursor D036.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the case split used by D022 and ultimately by result extraction.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: The left-associated trace constructor: first approximately compute M = YA^T YB, then L = XA M, then the final result C = L XB^T.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits the computed result to follow this three-stage association, with every stage satisfying its local additive-error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: The right-associated trace constructor: first approximately compute M = YA^T YB, then R = M XB^T, then the final result C = XA R.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits the computed result to follow this alternative three-stage association, with every stage satisfying its local additive-error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: The error-matrix field of a certified multiplication stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the additive error used by D025 and constrained by D034.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for a multiplication stage. Given an error E in R^(m x p) and a proof ||E||_F <= gamma(n,u)||A||_F||B||_F, it certifies the approximate multiplication of A in R^(m x n) and B in R^(n x p).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It imposes the only rounding-error model on each trace stage.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: Column orthonormality for X in R^(b x r): for all j,k in Fin r, sum_i X_(ij)X_(ik) equals 1 when j=k and 0 otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run requires this property for XA and XB, but not for YA or YB.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: The recursor for the trace type, with one branch for the left-associated constructor and one for the right-associated constructor.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enables association-independent extraction of the final computed result.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction of two propositions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Both displayed error inequalities must hold simultaneously.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type consisting of natural numbers smaller than n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes matrix rows and columns and makes all matrix sums finite.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The addition operation selected by an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the supplied instances it realizes ordinary real addition and, through matrix instances, pointwise matrix addition.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplication operation selected by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the supplied real instance it realizes all scalar products in gamma factors, norms, and error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The subtraction operation selected by an HSub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms matrix errors computed-result minus reference-product and the denominator 1-ku.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The less-than-or-equal relation selected by an LE instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real-order instance it expresses all norm bounds and the assumption 0 <= u.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.sub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise subtraction on matrices induced by subtraction of their entries.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes each matrix difference in the two Frobenius-norm errors entrywise subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The universally quantified dimensions b and r, as well as finite indices and exponents, are natural numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of a natural-number literal in a type with a corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real literals such as 1 and 2 and natural literals used by the definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds the numeral-1 interpretation from a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the real literal 1 in 1-ku and 1+gammaC with the ordinary real number one.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, norms, parameters, gamma factors, and inequalities are real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets every scalar sum in the bounds and in kappa.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary non-strict order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the standard meaning to every <= relation.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the standard meaning to all scalar products.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative identity 1 in the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the constant one in gamma denominators, correction factors, and orthonormality equations.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real subtraction, implemented as addition of the additive inverse.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the denominator 1-ku in every gamma factor.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The adapter turning an ordinary homogeneous Add operation into an HAdd operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HAdd expressions to ordinary addition on reals and matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The adapter turning an ordinary homogeneous Mul operation into an HMul operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HMul expressions to ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The adapter turning an ordinary homogeneous Sub operation into an HSub operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HSub expressions to ordinary real or pointwise matrix subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division operation supplied by a division-and-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real numbers it provides the division used in gamma(k,u) = ku/(1-ku).

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite enumeration of all elements of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits sums over every row, column, and contracted matrix index.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finite summation in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines matrix products, Frobenius norms, and column inner products.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each unqualified sum ranges over all valid finite matrix indices.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division operation selected by an HDiv instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It performs the real division in the definition of gamma.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in alpha is a function m -> n -> alpha.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This function representation underlies all square and rectangular matrices in the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: Casting a natural number into a type with a NatCast instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets b, r, and multiplication inner dimensions as real numbers in kappa and gamma factors.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies zero and associative commutative addition for all finite real sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real-number multiplication, inverse, and division structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides ordinary real division for gamma factors.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard embedding of natural numbers into the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes all dimension casts in kappa and gamma exact natural-to-real casts.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonnegative real square root.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies sqrt(r) in kappa and the square root of the sum of squared entries in the Frobenius norm.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The adapter turning an ordinary homogeneous Div operation into an HDiv operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes the gamma quotient to ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a numeral n certified to be at least two, this interprets n by its natural-number cast.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the real literal 2 in kappa as the real number obtained by casting natural 2.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the factor-approximation identities, the stage constructions, index equality in the Kronecker delta, and orthonormality equations.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The exponentiation operation selected by an HPow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It squares each real matrix entry in the Frobenius norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict-order relation selected by an LT instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real instance it expresses the run assumption (b+2r sqrt(r))u < 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.add
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise matrix addition induced by addition of entries.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the identities Atilde = A+EA, Btilde = B+EB and every stage result = exact product + error their entrywise meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural-number exponentiation in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real numbers it interprets the square A_(ij)^2 in the Frobenius norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.AtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proposition witnessing that a natural numeral is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used only to validate numeral interpretation and adds no mathematical assumption about b, r, or the run.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary strict order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the standard meaning to kappa u < 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real natural powers, particularly squaring in the Frobenius norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive identity 0 in the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies zero in 0 <= u and in off-diagonal orthonormality equations.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds the numeral-0 interpretation from a type's additive identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies real literal 0 with the ordinary real zero.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the type-level expression 1+1 used to establish the numeral-2 instance.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The adapter turning a Pow operation into a homogeneous HPow operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes entrywise exponentiation to ordinary real natural powers.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard interpretation of every natural-number literal as that same natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural literals such as the exponent 2.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqFin
dependency_coverage.meaning: A decision procedure for equality of two elements of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits the conditional defining the diagonal/off-diagonal value in column orthonormality.

dependency_coverage.name: ite
dependency_coverage.meaning: The if-then-else operation on a decidable proposition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the Kronecker-delta value: 1 when two column indices are equal and 0 otherwise.

binders: Natural numbers b and r, with no positivity assumptions.
An admissible run containing A,B in R^(b x b); XA,YA,XB,YB in R^(b x r); real numbers epsilon, betaA, betaB, and u; approximation errors EA,EB in R^(b x b); and a certified computation trace.
hypotheses: With kappa = b + 2r sqrt(r), one has kappa u < 1.
XA has orthonormal columns: for all j,k in {0,...,r-1}, sum_i XA_(ij) XA_(ik) is 1 if j=k and 0 otherwise.
XB has orthonormal columns in the same sense.
Atilde := XA YA^T satisfies Atilde = A + EA.
Btilde := YB XB^T satisfies Btilde = B + EB.

The trace uses either association ((XA (YA^T YB)) XB^T) or (XA ((YA^T YB) XB^T)). Each of its three approximate multiplication stages has result PQ+E and satisfies ||E||_F <= gamma(n,u)||P||_F||Q||_F, where n is that stage's inner dimension and gamma(n,u)=nu/(1-nu).
conclusions: Let C_hat be the final result extracted from the trace and gammaC = kappa u/(1-kappa u). Then ||C_hat - Atilde Btilde||_F <= gammaC ||Atilde||_F ||Btilde||_F.
Simultaneously, ||C_hat - AB||_F <= gammaC ||A||_F ||B||_F + epsilon(1+gammaC)(betaA ||B||_F + ||A||_F betaB + epsilon betaA betaB).
mathematical_definitions: Fin n is the index set {0,...,n-1}; an m-by-n real matrix is indexed by Fin m x Fin n.
Matrix multiplication is (PQ)_(ij) = sum_k P_(ik)Q_(kj), and transpose is (P^T)_(ji)=P_(ij).
The Frobenius norm is ||P||_F = sqrt(sum_i sum_j P_(ij)^2).
Atilde = XA YA^T and Btilde = YB XB^T.
kappa = b + 2r sqrt(r), with natural dimensions cast to real numbers.
C_hat is the final-stage matrix from either permitted three-stage multiplication trace.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every pair of natural dimensions b and r and every packaged run satisfying the stated unit-roundoff condition, orthonormal-column conditions, factor-approximation identities and error bounds, and one of the two certified three-stage multiplication traces, the final computed matrix obeys both a Frobenius-norm error bound relative to the product of the approximating matrices Atilde and Btilde and the displayed expanded Frobenius-norm error bound relative to the original product AB.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The dimensions b and r may be zero; empty index sets, empty sums, and degenerate matrices are therefore included.
The proposition quantifies over runs but does not prove that a run exists. Whenever the packaged assumptions are inconsistent, the universal statement has no inhabitants to test and is vacuous.
In particular, orthonormal columns in R^b cannot exist when r>b, so no run exists for those dimensions.

No separate assumptions state epsilon >= 0, betaA >= 0, or betaB >= 0. Run existence and the two approximation inequalities force the products epsilon betaA and epsilon betaB to be nonnegative, but do not force the individual factors to be nonnegative.
Only XA and XB are required to have orthonormal columns; YA and YB are unrestricted apart from their dimensions and participation in the packaged approximations and trace.
The norm is specifically the Frobenius norm, not the spectral or operator norm.

The computation model covers exactly the two listed parenthesizations and three additive-error multiplication stages. It does not encode a floating-point format, representability, overflow, underflow, or a deterministic rounding operation.
The stage errors and approximation errors are data packaged inside a run; the conclusion contains no new existential claim about obtaining them.
The trace result need not be unique: any stored stage errors satisfying the local bounds may define an admissible trace.
The condition u>=0 and kappa u<1 makes 1-kappa u positive, so gammaC has a nonzero positive denominator.
